name: Phrase TMS Translator
description: Localize Drupal websites with the help of professional translation tools.
project_description:
Easily translate your Drupal content with the Phrase Translation Plugin for TMGMT.

 At Phrase, we’re transforming language technology, opening the door to global business so you can reach more people, make deeper connections, and drive growth.

Our comprehensive platform of translation tools is intuitive to use and simple to integrate so you can focus on forming deeper connections with people across cultures.

 Using Phrase TMS and Drupal together ensures that you deliver your multi-channel marketing content to the right person at the right time, and in their preferred language.

 Why Drupal + Phrase TMS? 

 
 Automate everything with Phrase TMS. Phrase TMS manages the back and forth between Drupal and your translators by automatically pulling content into Phrase for translation and pushing the completed translations back to you in Drupal as soon as the translations are complete. 
 Boost productivity and reduce costs with AI-powered machine translation. Phrase TMS supports 30+ machine translation engines and automatically selects the optimal engine for your content. 
 Live In-context Preview gives translators proper context while they’re working. Translators can see exactly how their translations will look on the page, reducing feedback loops and improving translation quality. 
 Phrase TMS is vendor agnostic. You can work with your preferred translators, whether that is a translation agency or freelance translators. 
 With translation memory features, Phrase TMS will save all of your translations and allow you to reuse them wherever possible, making for faster, cheaper, and more reliable translations. 
 Improve translation quality and consistency. Phrase TMS’s robust, in-built quality assurance, spelling, and grammar checks ensure that the right terminology and tone is used across all your content. 
 
 The Phrase TMS integration supports Drupal 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11.

 This project supports all of the features provided by the TMGMT module. Visit our Help Center for support and assistance.

 Requirements 
 The Phrase TMS Integration for the TMGMT module requires the Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) module module and a Business or Enterprise plan with Phrase. Contact us for more information about licensing or to arrange a demo.
